description: Foundation layer: extend shared types, cart context, wishlist context, reviews utilities, CSS classes, root layout provider, and header updates. All subsequent FEATs depend on this one being complete first.
steps: 1. Add new interfaces to lib/types.ts: WishlistItem { product: Product }, CustomerOrder { id, date, items: CartItem[], subtotal, delivery: DeliveryInfo, payment: PaymentMethod, status }, DeliveryInfo { name, phone, address, state, notes }, PaymentMethod (union type 'card' | 'bank-transfer' | 'pay-on-delivery'), Review { id, productSlug, productName, rating, text, date, authorName }. Keep existing CartItem export.

2. Extend lib/cart-context.tsx: add updateQty(slug: string, qty: number) to CartContextValue interface and implementation. If qty <= 0 remove item; otherwise update quantity. Add to the useMemo value. No other changes.

3. Create lib/wishlist-context.tsx: WishlistProvider with localStorage key 'oilinga_wishlist'. Context value: items: WishlistItem[], addToWishlist(product: Product), removeFromWishlist(slug: string), isInWishlist(slug: string) => boolean, toggleWishlist(product: Product). SSR guard in readWishlist (typeof window !== 'undefined' check). Hydrate on mount via useEffect. Persist on every items change via useEffect. Export useWishlist() hook with error if used outside provider.

4. Create lib/reviews.ts (NOT a context — plain util module): export const REVIEWS_KEY = 'oilinga_reviews'. Export readReviews(): Review[] with SSR guard + try/catch. Export writeReview(r: Review): void (appends, writes back). Export reviewsForProduct(slug: string): Review[]. Export averageRating(slug: string): number | null (null if no reviews). All types imported from lib/types.ts.
5. Modify app/layout.tsx: import WishlistProvider from lib/wishlist-context.tsx. Wrap CartProvider with WishlistProvider: <WishlistProvider><CartProvider>{children}</CartProvider></WishlistProvider>.

acceptance_criteria: lib/types.ts exports WishlistItem, CustomerOrder, DeliveryInfo, PaymentMethod, Review without TypeScript errors
lib/cart-context.tsx exposes updateQty in CartContextValue and the hook returns it
lib/wishlist-context.tsx compiles; useWishlist() is accessible and toggleWishlist adds/removes from items array
lib/reviews.ts compiles; readReviews returns [] when localStorage is empty; writeReview appends and persists
app/layout.tsx wraps with WishlistProvider without error
assets/styles/app.css Phase 3 section added with all listed classes
SiteHeader shows cart icon linking to /cart with badge when cart is non-empty
verification: cd /Users/mac/Desktop/oilinga && yarn build — must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors
findings: All foundation types, contexts, and utilities are in place. Key exports for later FEATs: WishlistItem/CustomerOrder/DeliveryInfo/PaymentMethod/Review from lib/types.ts; useWishlist() from lib/wishlist-context.tsx; readReviews/writeReview/reviewsForProduct/averageRating/REVIEWS_KEY from lib/reviews.ts; updateQty added to useCart(). CSS classes for cart, checkout, orders, reviews, wishlist are in assets/styles/app.css under the Phase 3 section. SiteHeader now shows cart icon with badge linking to /cart and wishlist icon linking to /wishlist. localStorage keys in use: oilinga.cart, oilinga_wishlist, oilinga_reviews. The oilinga_orders key is reserved for FEAT-002 (order placement/checkout). No new npm packages were added.
